The team behind the work
Yegor Korobeynikov
Founder & CEO
Yegor is the founder and CEO of Backspace Oddity, an AI-native GTM agency for B2B companies. He previously co-founded Superabundance (a venture studio for AI startups), led the RealtimeBoard-to-Miro rebrand and then the in-house Miro brand studio, and ran marketing at Sidekick Browser — acquired by Perplexity, now Comet.
Anna Barinova
Product Development Lead
Anna leads product development at Backspace Oddity. She has shipped 50+ products from scratch, built cross-functional processes inside teams of 35 or more, and architected design systems that scaled across products with up to 14M monthly active users.
Siraj Hasanov
AI Engineering Lead · Founder, Acris.ai
Siraj is the AI Engineering Lead at Backspace Oddity and the founder of Acris.ai. Previously a software engineer at Meta. Full-stack development, AI systems, web platforms. He builds production-grade infrastructure — from AI tools to high-performance websites.
How a conversation starts
Pick a slot that works for you. It's a 30-minute conversation — not a sales pitch, just one specific question about your situation.
We usually start by asking which one workflow you'd most want to change. That tends to shape everything else.
